goal: Learn pivot tables and lookups well enough to build a monthly sales dashboard in Excel
interpretation: In about 65 minutes of Hindi videos (each under 25 minutes), the learner can build a pivot table, pull data in with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, make pivot charts, and put together a slicer-driven monthly sales dashboard in Excel.
assumptions: Hindi or Hinglish videos are acceptable, since the learner understands Hindi better than English.
The learner has a modern Excel version (2016 or later, ideally 365) so that XLOOKUP and slicers are available.
The dashboard builder video is the practice project, and the learner follows along with their own sales data.

sub_topics.title: Pivot table basics: rows, columns, values, refresh, first slicer
sub_topics.why: This is the core skill, and the learner has never used a pivot table.

sub_topics.title: VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP for pulling data into a sales sheet
sub_topics.why: Lookups fill in product, price or city columns before the data is summarised.

sub_topics.title: Pivot charts
sub_topics.why: These turn pivot summaries into visuals for the dashboard.

sub_topics.title: Dashboard build: KPI cards, charts, connected slicers, layout
sub_topics.why: This is the end goal: a monthly sales dashboard.

picks.title: pivot table for beginners in excel in Hindi || Microsoft excel 2007,2010,2016
picks.reason: A beginner Hindi walkthrough of sales-data pivot tables. It covers inserting one, dragging fields to rows, columns and values, refreshing when records change, and adding a first slicer.

picks.title: How To Apply VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP Formula on Large Data in Excel [Hindi] #excel
picks.reason: Builds on the basic VLOOKUP video. It applies VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP to large data, using MATCH to find the column number and named ranges to simplify formulas.

evidence.quote: अगर आपके पास एक लार्ज डाटा है तो उस पर आप VLOOKUP या XLOOKUP कैसे अप्लाई करेंगे
हमें क्या लिखना है यहां पर लुकअप अरे यानी कि एक अरे हम डालेंगे यहां पर जिसका डाटा हम ढूंढ रहे हैं

picks.title: How to Create Pivot Charts? | Excel Pivot Table in Hindi | Excel Pivot Table Series - Part - 2
picks.reason: A Hindi walkthrough of creating a pivot chart together with its pivot table. It covers changing chart type, data labels and formatting, ready for the dashboard.

evidence.quote: Pivot Chart हम यहां पे बनाने वाले है, तो सबसे पहले मैं Control A बटन प्रेस करूंगा।

बेसिकली Pivot Table जो होता है उसी का ही Pivot Chart होता है। Table यहां पे आएगा-आएगा और Chart आएगा।

किसी भी आपको चार्ट पर सेलेक्ट करने के बाद एनालाइज वाले ऑप्शन पे जाएंगे और यहां इंसर्ट स्लाइसर पे जाएंगे

picks.confidence_note: At 22.7 minutes it is under the 25-minute limit. Pause and follow along with your own data.

warnings: The plan uses about 65 of the 90 minutes. I left the rest unused rather than add redundant videos.

A second dashboard build (oKdBEjcgzyw, 20.7 min) exists. It is a near-duplicate of the one I chose, so I did not pick it. The chosen one is monthly, has KPI cards and has a date slicer. You could watch the other one as optional extra practice.
No Hindi video gave a full, quoted XLOOKUP-only lesson. Both lookup videos are mostly VLOOKUP with some XLOOKUP, so practise XLOOKUP yourself.
The learner may need to pause and rewatch, since the dashboard video moves quickly.
Watch order: pivot basics, then lookups, then pivot charts, then the dashboard. If your sales sheet already has all columns filled, you can skip the lookups until you need them.
